shots.title: Detect branch-matching existing worktrees before worktree-check guidance (#499)
shots.notes: Added branch-aware parsing for `git worktree list --porcelain` and matching by active/conflicting branch or edited file path.

shots.title: Surface Claude Code EnterWorktree guidance with non-Claude fallback (#499)
shots.notes: The worktree-check denial now tells agents to enter an existing matching worktree with EnterWorktree when available, with `cd` + relaunch fallback for other harnesses.

shots.title: Re-evaluate session branch and mode after entering an existing worktree (#499)

hazards.description: The reconciliation behavior was already present from prior work; S139 verified it and surfaced it explicitly in guidance rather than duplicating code.

shots.notes: Confirmed existing SQLite integration coverage for a denied main-checkout session entering a worktree; guidance now states SLOPE will re-evaluate branch and mode after entry.

shots.title: Normalize guard recovery command allowlists before redirects and pipes (#499)
shots.notes: Adjusted shell splitting so `2>&1` is treated as redirection rather than an `&` command separator; recovery commands with stderr redirects now stay guard-exempt.

conditions.description: The Windows full suite continues to emit legacy temp-repo stderr noise, but all tests passed.

training.description: Recovery guards should prefer reuse before creation.
training.outcome: When an existing worktree is visible, the guard now tells agents how to enter it instead of only suggesting `slope worktree start`.

training.description: Shell allowlists need to understand redirection syntax.
training.outcome: `2>&1` no longer turns a safe recovery command into a blocked multi-command segment.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/guards/worktree-check.test.ts tests/cli/guards/worktree-check-integration.test.ts tests/cli/guards/worktree-reuse.test.ts` passed: 43 tests.
`corepack pnpm typecheck`, `corepack pnpm prepare`, and `corepack pnpm test` passed on Windows: 228 test files passed, 1 skipped; 3603 tests passed, 25 skipped.
`slope roadmap validate` passed with existing historical roadmap warnings.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Clean and clarifying. The guard already knew how to reconcile after worktree entry; it simply did not tell the agent to use that path when a matching worktree existed.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When a guard blocks, its first recovery option should be the least duplicative action that restores correct state.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The redirect failure came from treating the ampersand inside `2>&1` as a command separator.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S140 can narrow session-collision blocking with a clearer recovery-command parsing baseline.

bunker_locations: Do not suggest creating a new worktree before checking whether a relevant one already exists.
Shell splitters must distinguish redirection operators like `2>&1` from command chaining.
When reusing already-implemented behavior, add coverage or guidance rather than reimplementing it.
yardage_book_updates: worktree-check now parses branch names from `git worktree list --porcelain`.
worktree-check denial text now includes existing-worktree entry guidance with EnterWorktree and non-Claude fallback.
worktree-check continues to reconcile session role, branch, and worktree path after entering a worktree.
worktree-check recovery allowlist now accepts stderr redirection on safe recovery commands.
